evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking API changes. The commit modifies only a JSON config file (backend_versions.json). No CLI, HTTP endpoint, config schema, or persistence format changes.
evidence.documentation: No project-facing documentation is changed. The PR body includes a table showing old→new pins for each backend, which serves as a reasonable inline changelog for this type of infra change.
evidence.manual_release_testing: Four container images are updated in this commit, all of which are user-reachable if a user has those backends configured. The halogen image version bump (0.18.22→0.19.1) is the highest-risk change — a major/minor version jump that could alter API, flags, or behavior. No evidence that any human pulled and exercised the new images before merge.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after the single approval at 2026-11-06T19:29:57Z. The nathanw fix (commit 9183d005 by @sawansri) was pushed at 19:18:53Z, before the approval. The squash merge commit (50ffee11e) preserves the approved content faithfully.
evidence.review: Only one reviewer (@sawansri) approved the PR with no comments. Per docs/dev/contribute.md, containers/Docker subject-matter-expertise belongs to @superm1 and @siavashhub, neither of whom reviewed or were pinged. sawansri's listed subject areas (agents, tui, cli, new backends, launch, vLLM, new models) do not include Docker/containers. sawansri did author the nathanw hold-fix commit and merged the PR himself, but the review gap on container image changes remains.
evidence.security: Image pins are updated to new SHA-256 digests, which is the correct approach for supply-chain safety. No new external dependencies or network call paths introduced. The nathanw hold-down is a deliberate rollback to avoid a behavioral regression. No security concerns.
evidence.tests: No tests accompany this change — it touches only src/cpp/resources/backend_versions.json (4 lines changed, 4 lines added). CI launched four workflows for the release branch (Launchpad PPA succeeded; C++ server build/test and container build/push were in_progress at time of check). There is no automated test that pulls the new container images.

subject: Update container backend image pins (#4083)
summary: Updates container backend image pins for ds4:rocm, gufo:rocm, halogen:rocm (0.18.22→0.19.1), and llamacpp:halobox; holds llamacpp:nathanw on its previous image to avoid an AVX-512 SIGILL regression on CPUs without AVX-512.
